species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 48°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 14–70 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Kokanee
why: Water 48°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 16–60 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Trout
why: Water 48°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 14–40 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 48°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–34 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
